html:
G'oya

FIRST_VALUE va LAST_VALUE freymdagi birinchi va oxirgi qatorning qiymatini beradi. Oyna har bir mijozning to'lovlari, tartibi day, bir kun ichida id. Oyna funksiyasi qatorlar sonini kamaytirmaydi, shuning uchun har mijozga bitta qator qolishi uchun DISTINCT qo'yamiz.

Yechim

SELECT DISTINCT customer_id,
       FIRST_VALUE(amount) OVER w AS first_amount,
       LAST_VALUE(amount) OVER w AS last_amount
FROM payments
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY day, id
             ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING)

WINDOW w AS (...) oynani bir marta yozib, ikki joyda ishlatishga imkon beradi.

Tuzoqlar

LAST_VALUE ning standart freymi. Oynada ORDER BY bo'lsa, freym standart bo'yicha bo'lim boshidan joriy qatorgacha olinadi. Joriy qatordan keyingi to'lovlar unga kirmaydi va LAST_VALUE har safar joriy qatorning o'z summasini qaytaradi. Natijada har bir mijoz bir necha qatorda chiqadi:

Noto'g'riSELECT DISTINCT customer_id,
       FIRST_VALUE(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY day, id) AS first_amount,
       LAST_VALUE(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY day, id) AS last_amount
FROM payments

MIN va MAX vaqtni emas, summani solishtiradi. Namunada 10-mijoz 5-, 7- va 9-kunlarda 200, 50 va 350 to'lagan: birinchi to'lov 200, MIN esa 50 beradi.

ORDER BY id ham to'g'ri emas, shartda id kunlar tartibini bildirmasligi aytilgan.

Boshqa yo'l

Oxirgi to'lov bu teskari tartibdagi birinchi to'lov. FIRST_VALUE freymga bog'liq muammoga tushmaydi, chunki bo'limning birinchi qatori doim freym ichida:

SELECT DISTINCT customer_id,
       FIRST_VALUE(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY day, id) AS first_amount,
       FIRST_VALUE(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY day DESC, id DESC) AS last_amount
FROM payments
